name: list-row
title: List row
description: A row with a leading slot, a title, a muted subtitle and a trailing slot. Hover wash, no separator lines, 44px touch target on phones, truncation instead of wrapping.
docs: Example: <ListRow title="Customer quote as a PDF" subtitle="To try" active={selected === id} onSelect={() => open(id)} action={<CiteButton reference={ref} />} />. `active` sets aria-current and the selected wash; `action` sits beside the row button, never inside it.
